thread: Two infrastructure changes landed that reward teams who read changelogs. Beacon upgrades existing indexes in place without a rebuild, and existing API keys migrate to v2 in 2027-01. The second has a date attached to it, so it will not wait.

items.headline: v1 completions endpoint gets a shutdown date
items.why: The v1 completions endpoint stops accepting requests on 2026-12-01. Existing keys migrate to v2 in 2027-01, and streaming responses are unchanged between the two versions.
items.connection: If anything you run still calls v1, the migration is a calendar problem before it is an engineering one.

items.headline: Beacon adds hybrid search
items.why: Beacon now supports hybrid search, combining keyword and embedding scores in one query. It is available on all paid plans and adds no per-query charge, and existing indexes are upgraded in place without a rebuild.
items.connection: Hybrid retrieval removes one of the two systems many teams run side by side.
